.architecture-container code.inline-code => background: #1a1a2e; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #aad;
.architecture-container h1 => font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; color: #e5e5e5; border-bottom: 1px solid #333; padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
.architecture-container pre:not(.mermaid) => background: #111; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 1rem;
.architecture-container td => border: 1px solid #333; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; text-align: left;
.architecture-container th => border: 1px solid #333; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; text-align: left;
.chat-container => display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; max-width: 48rem; margin: 0 auto;
.composer => display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #333;
.composer button => padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #1a5; color: #fff; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer;
.composer input => flex: 1; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #111; color: #e5e5e5; font-size: 1rem;
.df-app => min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 104px 1fr; background: #0b0d10; color: #e4e8ed;
.df-banner => margin: 0; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #5d442c; border-radius: 8px; background: #201910; color: #ffb454; font-size: 12px;
.df-brand span => font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #5e6875; border-left: 1px solid #2a3039; padding-left: 12px;
.df-btn => background: #1a1f26; border: 1px solid #2a3039; color: #e4e8ed; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 11px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
.df-budget-table => width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; background: #15191f; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
.df-budget-table caption => padding-bottom: 6px; text-align: left; color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;

.df-budget-table thead th => text-align: left; color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039;
.df-checkpoint => background: #1a1f26; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 11px; color: #8993a0;

.df-chip => padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 999px; color: #8993a0; font-size: 9px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; white-space: nowrap;
.df-control-panel => display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 44px;
.df-cost-head => display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;
.df-cost-head h2 => margin: 0; color: #8993a0; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
.df-cost-table td => padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #20252d; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
.df-cost-table th => padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #20252d; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

.df-cost-table thead th => color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039;
.df-detail => display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background: #15191f; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px;
.df-detail-grid => display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr; gap: 14px; align-items: start;
.df-detail-id => font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #8993a0;
.df-event-time => font-size: 11px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #5e6875;
.df-field => background: #111419; border: 1px solid #2a3039; color: #e4e8ed; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 9px; font-size: 12px;
.df-filters => display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
.df-filters small => color: #5e6875; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
.df-head => display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px;
.df-kpi => background: #15191f; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;
.df-kpi-label => font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #8993a0; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
.df-live => color: #6ad6a4; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
.df-mark => width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #5d442c; border-radius: 9px; color: #ffb454; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; background: #201910; margin-bottom: 15px;
.df-metric => display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; background: #1a1f26; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px;
.df-metric small => font-size: 10px; color: #5e6875; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
.df-metrics => display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(110px, 1fr)); gap: 10px;
.df-mix-item => display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; color: #8993a0;
.df-panel => background: #15191f; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
.df-panel-head => display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #8993a0;
.df-panel-head strong => color: #e4e8ed; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;

.df-pill => display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
.df-policy-head => display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;
.df-policy-head h2 => margin: 0; color: #8993a0; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
.df-policy-summary => display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 18px; margin: 0 0 12px;
.df-policy-summary dt => color: #5e6875; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
.df-policy-table caption => padding-bottom: 6px; text-align: left; color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
.df-policy-table td => padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #20252d; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
.df-policy-table th => padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #20252d; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;

.df-policy-table thead th => color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039;
.df-rail => background: #101318; border-right: 1px solid #2a3039; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 13px 6px; gap: 9px;

.df-rail-link => width: 100%; min-height: 30px; padding: 7px 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; color: #8993a0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
.df-recent-meta => display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: #8993a0;
.df-recent-row => display: grid; grid-template-columns: 76px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #20252d;
.df-run-id => font-size: 11px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; color: #ffb454;
.df-snapshot-item small => font-size: 10px; color: #5e6875; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
.df-state => padding: 22px; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; color: #8993a0; background: #13171c;
.df-table => width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; background: #15191f; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;

.df-table th => text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039;
.df-tenant-select => display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 13px;
.df-tenant-select select => padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 4px; background: #111; color: inherit; font: inherit;
.df-top => height: 58px; padding: 0 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039; background: #111419; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
.df-trend-line => stroke: #77b7ff; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
.df-usage-table => width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; background: #15191f; border: 1px solid #2a3039; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
.df-usage-table caption => padding-bottom: 6px; text-align: left; color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;

.df-usage-table thead th => text-align: left; color: #8993a0; font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039;
.error-message => margin: 1rem 1rem 0; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #c33; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #321414; color: #f99;
.eve-avatar => width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid #333; flex-shrink: 0;
.mermaid-wrapper => background: #0d0d0d; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; margin: 1.5rem 0; overflow-x: auto;
.message strong => display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.6; margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
.messages => flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 1rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;
body => font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; background: #0a0a0a; color: #e5e5e5; min-height: 100vh;
header => display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #222;
